metric: Pairs of models whose copies are the same logic or a drifted version (other literal, extra filter or column) found by exact plus near-duplicate analysis; a pair from different families counts as wrong.
correctness: Unsafe suggestions are counted under Shared-model refactors, not here; labels checked by execution as for exact copies
held_out: Seed 1, 3,000 models (tuned on): 99.3% recall, 89.9% precision; held-out families 97.5% / 99.4%
caveats: Similar logic over the same table and join but from another generated family counts as a false pair, which understates precision. Earlier near-only recall of 74.7% was a scoring artifact (pairs the exact check already found counted as misses); corrected. Tuned on seed 1.
analysis: Fresh seed: near-duplicate pairs only 86.3% precision, 99.3% recall; repeated-work report 91.8% / 96.2%
performance: 3,000 models: exact 18 s, near-duplicates 77 s, repeated work 8 s, refactor verification 64 s (600 models: 4 s, 6 s, 2 s, 14 s)
